Self.Wiki: Disable horse override (formerly Horse Ride Override; the game's CSDisableHorseOverrideRegionMan). Inside it, this region decides whether Torrent can be summoned and ridden. It takes precedence over the collision's own Disable Torrent setting.

OverrideType.Wiki: 1: riding is disabled here. 2: riding is allowed here, even where the map would disable it. Any other value: no override. The game reads it as a byte. Retail uses 1 (22 regions) and 2 (20 regions).
